# California Apartment Association

> > The California Apartment Association (CAA) is the leading advocacy organization for rental housing providers in California, fighting rent control, defending property rights, and promoting housing production policies.

CAA represents rental housing owners and operators across California, engaging in legislative advocacy, grassroots campaigns, legal action, and policy analysis. The organization works to defeat rent control measures, support housing production legislation, and protect the interests of the rental housing industry at state and local levels.

## Key Topics

- Rent control opposition
- California housing policy
- Legislative advocacy
- Grassroots campaigns
- Just cause eviction laws
- Housing production
- Ballot initiatives
- Tenant protections
- COVID-19 rental assistance
- Eviction moratoriums
- Sacramento legislative action
- Gov. Gavin Newsom
- Assembly and Senate bills
- Affordable housing development
- Local ordinance challenges

## Legislative Victories and Advocacy

- [CAA stops tenant-unionizing bill on Senate floor](https://caanet.org/caa-stops-tenant-unionizing-bill-on-senate-floor): CAA grassroots campaign defeats SB 529 tenant-unionizing bill in Senate
- [CAA defeats rental-registry bill in committee](https://caanet.org/caa-defeats-rental-registry-bill-in-committee): CAA stops AB 2406 rental registry bill by Buffy Wicks in committee
- [Gov. Newsom signs CAA-backed housing-production bills](https://caanet.org/gov-newsom-signs-caa-backed-housing-production-bills): Gov. Newsom signs CAA-supported bills including SB 330 for housing production
- [CAA succeeds in removing ban on RUBS from legislation](https://caanet.org/caa-succeeds-in-removing-ban-on-rubs-from-legislation): CAA removes RUBS ban from SB 750 water submeter legislation
- [CAA urges members to call lawmakers, urge no votes on 'just cause' bills](https://caanet.org/caa-urges-members-to-call-lawmakers-urge-no-votes-on-just-cause-bills): CAA mobilizes members against AB 1481 just cause eviction legislation
- [Election 2018: CAA's political action committees help keep moderate voice in Legislature](https://caanet.org/election-2018-caas-political-action-committees-help-keep-moderate-voice-in-legislature): CAA PACs support moderate candidates in 2018 California legislative races

## Rent Control Campaigns

- [CAA-led campaign defeats rent control measure in Santa Cruz](https://caanet.org/caa-led-campaign-defeats-rent-control-measure-in-santa-cruz): CAA campaign successfully defeats Santa Cruz Measure M rent control initiative
- [Signatures filed to place rent control before Sacramento city voters in 2020](https://caanet.org/signatures-filed-to-place-rent-control-before-sacramento-city-voters-in-2020): Tenant advocates submit signatures for Sacramento rent control ballot measure
- [Culver City set to review draconian rent control policy](https://caanet.org/culver-city-set-to-review-draconian-rent-control-policy): Culver City Council to review strict rent control ordinance and registry
- [Effort to place rent control before Santa Ana voters falls short](https://caanet.org/effort-to-place-rent-control-before-santa-ana-voters-falls-short): Santa Ana rent control ballot initiative fails to gather enough signatures
- [Westminster council rebuffs push for rent control](https://caanet.org/westminster-council-rebuffs-push-for-rent-control): Westminster City Council rejects rent control after CAA testimony
- [CAA files brief with 2nd Circuit Court of Appeals supporting challenge to New York City's rent control law](https://caanet.org/caa-files-brief-with-2nd-circuit-court-of-appeals-supporting-challenge-to-new-york-citys-rent-control-law): CAA files amicus brief supporting NYC rent control challenge in 2nd Circuit

- [President Biden extends federal eviction moratorium until spring](https://caanet.org/president-biden-extends-federal-eviction-moratorium-until-spring): Biden extends federal eviction moratorium affecting California rental housing
- [Gov. Newsom urges swift distribution of federal rent relief](https://caanet.org/gov-newsom-urges-swift-distribution-of-federal-rent-relief): Gov. Newsom pushes for rapid distribution of federal rent relief funds
- [COVID-19 stimulus, job creation and affordable housing highlight proposed state budget](https://caanet.org/covid-19-stimulus-job-creation-and-affordable-housing-highlight-proposed-state-budget): Newsom's state budget proposal includes COVID stimulus and housing funding

## Local Policy and Eviction Controls

- [L.A. County delays vote on eviction controls amid CAA push-back](https://caanet.org/l-a-county-delays-vote-on-eviction-controls-amid-caa-push-back): LA County postpones eviction control vote following CAA advocacy efforts
- [San Jose bans evictions of furloughed federal workers for nonpayment of rent](https://caanet.org/san-jose-bans-evictions-of-furloughed-federal-workers-for-nonpayment-of-rent): San Jose passes emergency ordinance protecting furloughed workers from eviction
- [Sacramento continues to offer free mediation program](https://caanet.org/sacramento-continues-to-offer-free-mediation-program): Sacramento CARES offers free landlord-tenant mediation services
